Why You'll Love It

Dempsey Road Hunting Tract

Dempsey Road hunting tract with frontage on Dempsey Road and easy access. The property offers a good mix of pine and hardwood timber, providing excellent habitat for deer and turkey. A power line runs through the property, offering an ideal location for establishing a wildlife food plot. With its combination of timber, hunting opportunities, and potential food plot area, this tract would make a great homesite, hunting camp, or recreational getaway.
